pages.title: Hearth
pages.text: $(bold)The rest of Hearth and Harvest: pies, cakes and pizzas, sweets and snacks, cheese and butter, and its counters, drawers, cabinets and sink. Needs Kitchen as well.$(br2)$(thing)Iron Age$(n), ring 3.$(br)$(thing)7 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Gardener and Kitchen.
